newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil allows foreigners to hedge in derivatives.
newsitem.headline: Brazil allows foreigners to hedge in derivatives.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council (CMN) said it has authorized foreign investors under Annex Four rules to operate in derivatives markets for hedging transactions.

Central Bank International Affairs Director Gustavo Franco told reporters that the CMN has taken this decision because it realized that the Brazilian bolsa was losing attractiveness to other stock exchanges.
Brazil's Central Bank and the Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM) will work together on regulations specifying the hedge operations.
Annex Four regulates foreign investment in Brazil's stock market, debentures and privatization bonds.
